panels.title: Use — where the power is going
panels.description: Where the power goes, stacked: Unmetered at the bottom (house load less every metered load), each metered load above it, and power sent to PG&E on top when 'Sent to PG&E' is set to Show. Pick layers with 'Where it goes' at the top of the page. House load is not metered: it is solar production plus grid power, per quarter-hour, and only counts once the grid meter and (in daylight) the main array have both reported, so the newest quarter-hour is usually blank. A metered load with no reading in a bucket counts as 0 there, and its power shows up in Unmetered. Aggregate averages the breakdown into 15-minute to 1-day buckets; Auto keeps full detail up to 10 days and shows daily averages beyond.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900), 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), gb AS (
  -- PG&E's own hourly meter history (Green Button import), spread evenly
  -- over the hour's quarters. Used only where the Eagle has no reading.
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / 900) * 900 + o.off AS t,
         'pge' AS slug,
         SUM(CASE WHEN se.metric = 'grid_import_wh' THEN s.value ELSE -s.value END)
           * 3600.0 / MAX(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN (SELECT 0 AS off UNION ALL SELECT 900 UNION ALL SELECT 1800 UNION ALL SELECT 2700) o
    ON o.off < s.duration_s
  WHERE se.metric IN ('grid_import_wh', 'grid_export_wh')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / 3600) * 3600 - 3600, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY s.ts, o.off
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END),
                  MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'pge' THEN w END)) AS grid,
         MAX(slug = 'eagle') AS live_grid
  FROM (SELECT t, slug, w FROM raw
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t, slug, w FROM gb
        WHERE t >= ($__from / 1000 / 900) * 900 AND t < $__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND sl + grid >= 0
              THEN sl + grid END AS load
  FROM (SELECT p.*,
               -- An hourly PG&E reading pairs with the hour's mean solar;
               -- per-quarter solar against an hourly grid figure would go
               -- negative whenever production swung within the hour.
               CASE WHEN live_grid = 1
                    THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0)
                    ELSE AVG(COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY t / 3600)
               END AS sl
        FROM p)
), ticks(t) AS (
  SELECT ($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) FROM ticks WHERE t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) < $__to / 1000
)
, loads AS (
  -- Every metered load, as on the per-load charts below: any power series
  -- that isn't a source of energy or the grid meter.
  SELECT se.id AS series_id, so.name AS name
  FROM core_series se
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE so.kind NOT IN ('solar', 'grid', 'gas') AND se.unit = 'W'
), x AS (
  SELECT s.series_id, CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) AS st,
         CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) + s.duration_s AS en, s.value
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN loads l ON l.series_id = s.series_id
  WHERE s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000 - 86400, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
), m AS (
  -- Each load's mean over the part of the bucket its samples cover (a
  -- 30-minute Tesla reading spans several buckets).
  SELECT ticks.t AS t, l.name AS name,
         SUM(x.value * (MIN(x.en, ticks.t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) - MAX(x.st, ticks.t)))
           / SUM(MIN(x.en, ticks.t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) - MAX(x.st, ticks.t)) AS w
  FROM ticks
  JOIN x ON x.st < ticks.t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) AND x.en > ticks.t
  JOIN loads l ON l.series_id = x.series_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), layers AS (
  -- Unmetered is house load less every metered load, checked or not, so
  -- unchecking a load drops its layer instead of folding it into
  -- Unmetered. A load with no reading in a bucket counts as 0 there (its
  -- power, if any, lands in Unmetered); metering error can't push
  -- Unmetered below 0.
  SELECT ticks.t AS t, 0 AS ord, 'Unmetered' AS layer,
         CASE WHEN b.load IS NOT NULL
              THEN MAX(b.load - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(w) FROM m WHERE m.t = ticks.t), 0), 0)
         END AS w
  FROM ticks
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ticks.t, 1, l.name, COALESCE(m.w, 0)
  FROM ticks
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM loads) l
  LEFT JOIN m ON m.t = ticks.t AND m.name = l.name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ticks.t, 2, 'Sent to PG&E', MAX(-b.grid, 0)
  FROM ticks
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
  WHERE '${export}' = 'Show'
)
-- Display buckets: the Aggregate picker, or Auto -- the computed resolution
-- up to 10 days, a day beyond. Each display bucket is the mean of the
-- computed buckets inside it (unknown ones skipped), aligned to local
-- midnight using today's UTC offset (an hour off across a DST change).
, agg AS (
  SELECT CASE '${agg}'
           WHEN '15m' THEN 900 WHEN '1h' THEN 3600
           WHEN '6h' THEN 21600 WHEN '1d' THEN 86400
           ELSE CASE WHEN $__to - $__from > 10 * 86400000 THEN 86400 ELSE MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) END
         END AS d,
         CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', 'localtime') AS INTEGER)
           - CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS off
)
-- Long format. Grafana orders the series by name and stacks them in that
-- order, so each layer carries its stacking rank as a prefix ("0 Unmetered",
-- "1 Tesla", "2 Sent to PG&E"), stripped again by the panel's rename
-- transformation: Unmetered at the bottom, export on top.
SELECT ((t + agg.off) / agg.d) * agg.d - agg.off AS time,
       ord || ' ' || layer AS layer, AVG(w) AS value
FROM layers CROSS JOIN agg
WHERE layer IN (${stack:sqlstring}) OR layer = 'Sent to PG&E'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, MIN(ord), 2

SELECT layer AS "Where it went",
       SUM(w) * 900 / 3600000.0 AS "kWh",
       SUM(w) / SUM(SUM(w)) OVER () AS "Share"
FROM layers
WHERE layer IN (${stack:sqlstring}) OR layer = 'Sent to PG&E'

), x AS (
  SELECT s.series_id, CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) AS st,
         CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) + s.duration_s AS en, s.value
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN loads l ON l.series_id = s.series_id
  WHERE s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000 - 86400, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
), m AS (
  -- Each load's mean over the part of the bucket its samples cover (a
  -- 30-minute Tesla reading spans several buckets).
  SELECT ticks.t AS t, l.name AS name,
         SUM(x.value * (MIN(x.en, ticks.t + 900) - MAX(x.st, ticks.t)))
           / SUM(MIN(x.en, ticks.t + 900) - MAX(x.st, ticks.t)) AS w
  FROM ticks
  JOIN x ON x.st < ticks.t + 900 AND x.en > ticks.t
  JOIN loads l ON l.series_id = x.series_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), layers AS (
  -- Unmetered is house load less every metered load, checked or not, so
  -- unchecking a load drops its layer instead of folding it into
  -- Unmetered. A load with no reading in a bucket counts as 0 there (its
  -- power, if any, lands in Unmetered); metering error can't push
  -- Unmetered below 0.
  SELECT ticks.t AS t, 0 AS ord, 'Unmetered' AS layer,
         CASE WHEN b.load IS NOT NULL
              THEN MAX(b.load - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(w) FROM m WHERE m.t = ticks.t), 0), 0)
         END AS w
  FROM ticks
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ticks.t, 1, l.name, COALESCE(m.w, 0)
  FROM ticks
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM loads) l
  LEFT JOIN m ON m.t = ticks.t AND m.name = l.name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ticks.t, 2, 'Sent to PG&E', MAX(-b.grid, 0)
  FROM ticks
  LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
  WHERE '${export}' = 'Show'
)
-- Each layer's energy over the range: mean W per quarter-hour x 0.25 h.
-- Buckets where house load isn't known yet leave Unmetered out there.
SELECT layer AS "Where it went",
       SUM(w) * 900 / 3600000.0 AS "kWh",
       SUM(w) / SUM(SUM(w)) OVER () AS "Share"
FROM layers
WHERE layer IN (${stack:sqlstring}) OR layer = 'Sent to PG&E'
GROUP BY layer
ORDER BY MIN(ord), layer
